content.page_summary: Reference list (items 342–351) from a clinical guideline focused largely on studies of natriuretic peptide‑guided management and related outcomes in heart failure (including trials and meta-analyses). Many entries discuss N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) or B-type/brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) guided therapy.
